notes: Research-only expansion. No contact/send authority. Existing 2026-08-27 DNR cohort is intentionally excluded.

gguf_control.fact: CloudSurf calls the repository its official GGUF quantizations and says it quantized the model itself.

evaluation_harness.fact: CloudSurf publishes BFCL artifacts and tau2 trajectories for the base model.

quantization_gap.fact: The official card states the quantized-model evaluation is pending and BF16 benchmark numbers do not yet apply to the quants.

business_channel.fact: Public company/support surface for CloudSurf Software LLC.

disqualifiers: Bootstrapped/small company; $12k budget is not evidenced.
Their team may prefer to complete the pending evaluation internally.

gguf_control.fact: Liquid AI publishes multiple first-party GGUF variants, including PTQ and QAD Q4_0 checkpoints.

evaluation_harness.fact: Liquid AI publishes model-family benchmark and deployment evidence for LFM2.5.

quantization_gap.fact: First-party repository exposes both QAD and post-training Q4_0 variants, creating a concrete reversible same-format comparison surface.

disqualifiers: Liquid AI has substantial internal model/quantization capability; outside diagnostic demand is unproven.
No public request for third-party GGUF evaluation was observed in this research pass.

gguf_control.fact: Mistral publishes first-party GGUF checkpoints in Q8_0, Q5_K_M, and Q4_K_M.

evaluation_harness.fact: The model family has public release/benchmark context and a defined mistral-common reference path.

quantization_gap.fact: Mistral documented a config defect that caused long-context degradation and affected GGUFs produced before the fix; Magistral GGUF also warns llama.cpp's automatic chat template is likely incorrect.

disqualifiers: Known issues may already be internally understood/remediated.
Large internal inference team makes external diagnostic demand uncertain.

gguf_control.fact: IBM Granite owns a large first-party GGUF collection.

evaluation_harness.fact: IBM publishes automated GGUF conversion, quantization, build-verification, packaging and partner-delivery workflows.

quantization_gap.fact: The GGUF card carries base-model performance claims while the public GGUF card itself does not present a quant-vs-base acceptance table, leaving a measurable fidelity surface.

disqualifiers: IBM already has a dedicated GGUF CI/CD and verification pipeline, lowering likely external need.
No current public regression or request for external validation was identified in this pass.

gguf_control.fact: A high-traffic GGUF exists, but the observed artifact is published by a third party, not XHToken.

evaluation_harness.fact: Spark-X2.5 publishes extensive benchmark results and deployment instructions.

quantization_gap.fact: The family added fresh llama.cpp architecture support and multiple quantized deployment paths in September 2026.

disqualifiers: Fails the current offer's buyer-controls-GGUF gate on observed evidence; keep RESEARCH_INCOMPLETE until a first-party controlled GGUF is proven.
